# Apple Support Community

> > Apple's official peer-to-peer support community where users discuss troubleshooting, features, and best practices across all Apple devices and services.

discussions.apple.com is Apple's primary community forum platform hosting discussions for iPhone, macOS, iPad, Apple Watch, and other Apple products. Users share technical support, troubleshooting tips, and product experiences moderated by community experts.

## Key Topics

- iPhone
- macOS
- iPad
- Apple Watch
- iCloud
- Apple ID
- iOS
- AirPods
- Apple Music
- Apple Vision Pro
- Apple Intelligence
- troubleshooting
- technical support
- device setup
- account management

## Getting Started

- [Official Apple Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com): Apple's main support community hub for iPhone, macOS, iPad, Apple Watch.
- [Welcome to Apple Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/welcome): Welcome page for Apple Support Community with product categories.
- [Browse Community Discussions](https://discussions.apple.com/browse): Searchable, filterable directory of Apple community discussions.
- [How to Use the Apple Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/learn): Guide to using Apple Support Community features and guidelines.

## Apple Devices

- [iPhone Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/iphone): iPhone community forum for iOS support and troubleshooting.
- [macOS Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/macos): macOS community forum for Sequoia, Sonoma, and Tahoe support.
- [Mac Hardware Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/mac): Mac hardware community for MacBook Pro, iMac, Mac mini support.
- [iPad Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/ipad): iPad community forum for iPad and iPad Pro support.
- [Apple Watch Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/watch): Apple Watch community for Series 11, Ultra, SE support.

## Apple Services & Accounts

- [Apple Account Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/apple-account): Apple ID and account management community support forum.
- [iCloud Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/icloud): iCloud sync and storage community for iOS, Mac, PC users.
- [Apple Music Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/music): Apple Music and iTunes community for streaming support.

## Apple Accessories & Peripherals

- [AirPods Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/airpods): AirPods community for connectivity and pairing troubleshooting.
- [Accessories Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/accessories): Apple accessories community for Pencil Pro, displays, peripherals.

## Apple Applications & Features

- [Applications and Services Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/applications-services): Community for Apple apps like FaceTime, Clips, Compressor.
- [Apple Intelligence Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/apple-intelligence): Apple Intelligence community for Siri and AI feature support.
- [TV and Home Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/tv-and-home): Apple TV, HomePod, HomeKit community for home automation.

## Emerging Technologies

- [Apple Vision Pro Support Community](https://discussions.apple.com/community/apple-vision-pro): Apple Vision Pro community for device setup and troubleshooting.
